payload.summary: CME entries accept documentId/routineId without checking the referenced row belongs to the same owner
payload.detail: POST and PATCH on /api/cme/entries accept documentId and routineId and write them without verifying the referenced row is the caller's. On Call has assertValidLinkedDocumentIds for exactly this; CME has no equivalent, and the database foreign keys do not enforce ownership. There is no live leak today: the UI shows only a boolean 'attached' flag and never resolves the id. It becomes a cross-tenant existence oracle the moment any screen resolves that id to show a document title or a link — an owner could attach another owner's document id and learn whether it exists, and then see its title. Deliberately not fixed in PR #2902 to avoid widening a seventy-file change; both acceptance points carry a comment stating what is unchecked, why it is safe today and what makes it unsafe. Fix before any screen resolves a linked document.
